title: Kasblar va ish joylari
goal_uz: Dars oxirida yigirmata kasb nomini ayta olasiz, What do you do? va Where do you work? savollarini berasiz va ularga javob qaytarasiz hamda o‘zingiz va tanishlaringiz haqida gapirasiz.

scenes.title: Oltinchi darsga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oltinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda “to be” fe’lini, ya’ni am, is, are ni o‘rgandik va oddiy gaplar tuzdik. Bugun shu gaplarga yangi so‘zlar qo‘shamiz: yigirmata kasb va ish joylari. Dars oxirida “What do you do?” va “Where do you work?” savollariga javob bera olasiz, o‘zingiz va tanishlaringiz haqida gapirasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we learn twenty jobs and places of work.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun yigirmata kasb va ish joylarini o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: What do you do?
scenes.say_native: Yangi tanishuvda eng ko‘p so‘raladigan savollardan biri — “What do you do?”. Tarjimasi “nima qilasiz?” bo‘lsa-da, aslida bu “kasbingiz nima?” degan ma’noni beradi. Ya’ni savol hozir nima qilayotganingizni emas, doimiy ishingizni so‘raydi. Xuddi shu ma’noni “What’s your job?” ham beradi. Ikkalasi ham tabiiy, lekin birinchisi suhbatda ko‘proq uchraydi.
scenes.say: What do you do? What's your job?
scenes.say_uz: Kasbingiz nima? Ishingiz nima?

scenes.title: Javob: I’m a …
scenes.say_native: Javob berish juda oson, chunki o‘tgan darsdagi qolipni ishlatamiz: “I’m a” va keyin kasb nomi. “I’m a doctor” — men shifokorman. Boshqa odam haqida: “He’s a driver”, “She’s a nurse”. Demak, bugungi dars yangi grammatika emas, balki o‘tgan darsdagi “to be” ga yangi so‘zlar qo‘shishdir. Kasb nomlarini bilsangiz bas, gap tayyor.
scenes.say: I'm a doctor. He's a driver. She's a nurse.
scenes.say_uz: Men shifokorman. U haydovchi. U hamshira.

scenes.title: Kasblar: yordam beradiganlar
scenes.say_native: Birinchi guruh — odamlarga yordam beradigan kasblar. “Teacher” — o‘qituvchi. “Doctor” — shifokor. “Nurse” — hamshira. “Dentist” — tish shifokori. Hammasi oldida “a” turibdi. “Nurse” ayol ham, erkak ham bo‘lishi mumkin: ingliz tilida bu so‘z jinsga bog‘liq emas. O‘zbekchada “hamshira” so‘zi ko‘pincha ayolni anglatadi, inglizchada esa erkak hamshira ham “nurse”.
scenes.say: A teacher. A doctor. A nurse. A dentist.
scenes.say_uz: O‘qituvchi. Shifokor. Hamshira. Tish shifokori.

scenes.title: Kasblar: texnik ishlar
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi guruh — texnik kasblar. “Engineer” — muhandis. “Programmer” — dasturchi, kompyuter dasturlarini yozadigan odam. “Mechanic” — mexanik, mashinalarni ta’mirlaydi. “Builder” — quruvchi. Diqqat qiling: “engineer” oldida “an”, chunki so‘z unli tovush bilan boshlanadi. Qolganlarida “a”. Ularni qaytarib ayting va tasavvur qiling: har biri qayerda ishlaydi?
scenes.say: An engineer. A programmer. A mechanic. A builder.
scenes.say_uz: Muhandis. Dasturchi. Mexanik. Quruvchi.

scenes.title: Qaysi kasb?
scenes.say_native: Ta’rifni eshiting va kasbni toping. Birinchi: kasal odamlarga yordam beradi. Ikkinchi: uylar quradi. Uchinchi: bolalarga dars beradi. To‘rtinchi: kompyuter dasturlarini yozadi. Har biriga bitta kasb nomini “He is” yoki “She is” bilan boshlab ayting. Hamshira ham, shifokor ham to‘g‘ri bo‘lishi mumkin, lekin sizga mos birini tanlang.
scenes.say: He helps sick people. He builds houses. She teaches children. She writes computer programs.
scenes.say_uz: U kasallarga yordam beradi. U uy quradi. U bolalarga dars beradi. U kompyuter dasturlarini yozadi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Kasallarga yordam beradigan erkak — “He is a doctor”. Uy quradigan erkak — “He is a builder”. Bolalarga dars beradigan ayol — “She is a teacher”. Dastur yozadigan ayol — “She is a programmer”. Birinchi gapda “nurse” ham deyish mumkin edi, ikkalasi ham kasallarga yordam beradi. Yaxshi, ko‘rib turibsiz: kasb nomi ma’noni egallagach, gap o‘zi tuziladi.
scenes.say: He is a doctor. He is a builder. She is a teacher. She is a programmer.
scenes.say_uz: U shifokor. U quruvchi. U o‘qituvchi. U dasturchi.

scenes.title: Kasb oldida a yoki an
board: a teacher · a doctor · a nurse
scenes.say_native: O‘zbekchada “Men o‘qituvchiman” deymiz, “bir o‘qituvchi” demaymiz. Inglizchada esa kasb oldida doim “a” yoki “an” turadi: “I’m a teacher”. Agar kasb nomi unli tovush bilan boshlansa, “an” qo‘yamiz: “an engineer”, “an accountant”, “an actor”. Undosh tovush bilan boshlansa, “a”: “a nurse”, “a pilot”, “a doctor”. Tanlovni harf emas, birinchi tovush belgilaydi. Shuni quloq bilan tekshirib ko‘ring.
scenes.say: A teacher. An engineer. An accountant. A pilot.
scenes.say_uz: O‘qituvchi. Muhandis. Buxgalter. Uchuvchi.

scenes.title: Artiklni unutish
scenes.say_native: Bu darsning eng ko‘p uchraydigan xatosi — artiklni tushirib qoldirish: “I’m teacher”. O‘zbekchadan o‘tib kelgan odat. Inglizchada bunday deyilmaydi, “a” kerak. Ikkinchi xato — “a” va “an” ni almashtirish: “a engineer” emas, “an engineer”. Eslab qoling: kasbni aytayotganda avval “I’m”, keyin “a” yoki “an”, keyin kasb. Uchta qadam, uchta bo‘g‘in.
scenes.say: I'm a teacher. I'm an engineer. Don't forget a or an.
scenes.say_uz: Men o‘qituvchiman. Men muhandisman. A yoki an ni unutmang.

scenes.title: A yoki an?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta kasb. Har birining oldiga “a” yoki “an” qo‘ying va butun iborani ayting. Birinchi: nurse. Ikkinchi: engineer. Uchinchi: accountant. To‘rtinchi: pilot. Harfga emas, birinchi tovushga qarang. Shubha qilsangiz, so‘zni ovoz chiqarib ayting va birinchi tovushni eshiting: unli tovush eshitilsa, “an” kerak.
scenes.say: Nurse. Engineer. Accountant. Pilot.
scenes.say_uz: Hamshira. Muhandis. Buxgalter. Uchuvchi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. “A nurse”, chunki “n” undosh. “An engineer”, chunki “e” unli. “An accountant”, chunki “a” unli tovush bilan boshlanadi. “A pilot”, chunki “p” undosh. Qoida oddiy: unli tovush oldida “an”, undosh tovush oldida “a”. Yanglishsangiz, quloqqa tayaning: “a engineer” eshitilganda og‘izga yoqmaydi, “an engineer” esa yengil aytiladi.
scenes.say: A nurse. An engineer. An accountant. A pilot.
scenes.say_uz: Hamshira. Muhandis. Buxgalter. Uchuvchi.

scenes.title: Kasblar: ofis va savdo
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi guruh — ofis va savdo kasblari. “Manager” — menejer, boshliq. “Accountant” — buxgalter. “Lawyer” — advokat yoki yurist. “Shop assistant” — do‘kon sotuvchisi. Bu oxirgi ibora ikki so‘zdan iborat, lekin bitta kasb nomi sifatida o‘rganing. Amerika inglizchasida “shop assistant” o‘rniga ko‘pincha “salesperson” yoki “sales clerk” deyiladi, Britaniyada esa “shop assistant” keng tarqalgan.
scenes.say: A manager. An accountant. A lawyer. A shop assistant.
scenes.say_uz: Menejer. Buxgalter. Advokat. Sotuvchi.

scenes.title: Kasblar: oziq-ovqat va xizmat
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi guruh — ovqat va xizmat sohasi. “Cook” — oshpaz. “Waiter” — ofitsiant. “Baker” — novvoy, ya’ni non va shirinlik yopuvchi usta. “Hairdresser” — sartarosh yoki soch ustasi. Ingliz tilida soch olishni bilgan usta ham erkak, ham ayol bo‘lsa “hairdresser” deyiladi. Barber esa faqat erkaklar sartaroshi. Hozircha asosiylarini yod oling.
scenes.say: A cook. A waiter. A baker. A hairdresser.
scenes.say_uz: Oshpaz. Ofitsiant. Novvoy. Sartarosh.

scenes.title: Kasblar: transport va tashqarida
scenes.say_native: Beshinchi, oxirgi guruh. “Driver” — haydovchi. “Pilot” — uchuvchi. “Farmer” — fermer yoki dehqon. “Police officer” — politsiya xodimi. Jami yigirmata kasbni ko‘rib chiqdik. Hozir hammasi yodingizda qolgan bo‘lishi shart emas, bu normal. Dars davomida va uy vazifasida ularni yana ko‘p ishlatasiz, shunda o‘z-o‘zidan eslab qolasiz.
scenes.say: A driver. A pilot. A farmer. A police officer.
scenes.say_uz: Haydovchi. Uchuvchi. Fermer. Politsiya xodimi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: urg‘u qayerda?
scenes.say_native: Kasb nomlarining urg‘usiga e’tibor bering. “Teacher”, “doctor”, “dentist” — urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda. “Engineer” — oxirgi bo‘g‘inda: engi-NEER. “Mechanic” — ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: me-CHAN-ic. “Accountant” — ikkinchisida: ac-COUNT-ant. “Programmer” va “manager” — birinchisida. “Police officer” — “po-LICE OFF-i-cer”. Urg‘u noto‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, so‘zni tushunish qiyinlashadi.
scenes.say: Teacher. Doctor. Engineer. Mechanic. Accountant. Programmer. Police officer.
scenes.say_uz: O‘qituvchi. Shifokor. Muhandis. Mexanik. Buxgalter. Dasturchi. Politsiya xodimi.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Endi takrorlang. Men so‘zni ayting, keyin siz xuddi shunday ayting. Urg‘uli bo‘g‘inni kuchliroq va cho‘ziqroq talaffuz qiling. Qolgan bo‘g‘inlar yengil bo‘lsin. Ovozingizni yozib olib, tinglab ko‘rsangiz, juda foydali bo‘ladi. Urg‘u to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, so‘zlarni suhbatdoshingiz osongina tushunadi, hatto tovushlarni biroz noaniq aytsangiz ham.
scenes.say: Engineer. Accountant. Mechanic. Police officer.
scenes.say_uz: Muhandis. Buxgalter. Mexanik. Politsiya xodimi.

scenes.title: Erkak va ayol shakli yo‘q
board: a doctor = erkak ham, ayol ham
a teacher = erkak ham, ayol ham
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida ham kasb nomlarida erkak va ayol shakli yo‘q: “shifokor” deymiz, kim bo‘lishidan qat’i nazar. Rus tilida esa ba’zan bor. Inglizcha ham o‘zbekchaga o‘xshaydi: “doctor”, “teacher”, “engineer” ham erkakka, ham ayolga to‘g‘ri keladi. Faqat bir nechta eski juftlik bor: “waiter” va “waitress”, “actor” va “actress”. Hozir ko‘pchilik ikkala jins uchun ham “waiter” va “actor” deydi. Ayolga alohida shakl yasash shart emas.
scenes.say: A doctor can be a man or a woman. Waiter and waitress are the old pair.
scenes.say_uz: Doctor erkak ham, ayol ham bo‘lishi mumkin. Waiter va waitress eski juftlik.

scenes.title: Doctoress degan so‘z yo‘q
board: ✓ He is a police officer. (policeman — eski)
scenes.say_native: Ba’zi talabalar “doctor” dan ayol shaklini yasashga urinadi: “doctoress” kabi. Bunday so‘z yo‘q. “She is a doctor” — to‘liq to‘g‘ri gap. Yana bir narsa: “policeman” va “policewoman” o‘rniga bugun “police officer” deyiladi, chunki bu so‘z ikkala jins uchun mos. “Fireman” o‘rniga ham “firefighter”. Yangi, jinsga bog‘liq bo‘lmagan so‘zlar hozir ko‘proq uchraydi.
scenes.say: She is a doctor. He is a police officer. Say police officer, not policeman.
scenes.say_uz: U shifokor. U politsiya xodimi. Policeman emas, police officer deng.

scenes.title: Gap tuzing
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta odam va ularning kasblari berilgan. Har biri haqida to‘liq gap tuzing. Dilya o‘qituvchi, Bobur haydovchi, Sara hamshira, Ali muhandis. Eslang: ayol uchun “she”, erkak uchun “he”. Va “a” yoki “an” ni unutmang. Ali uchun qaysi biri kerak? O‘ylab ko‘ring.
scenes.say: Dilya, teacher. Bobur, driver. Sara, nurse. Ali, engineer.
scenes.say_uz: Dilya, o‘qituvchi. Bobur, haydovchi. Sara, hamshira. Ali, muhandis.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “Dilya is a teacher”. “Bobur is a driver”. “Sara is a nurse”. “Ali is an engineer”. Ali uchun “an” kerak edi, chunki “engineer” unli tovush bilan boshlanadi. Siz ismni ham, olmoshni ham ishlatishingiz mumkin: “Dilya is a teacher” yoki “She is a teacher”. Ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: Dilya is a teacher. Bobur is a driver. Sara is a nurse. Ali is an engineer.
scenes.say_uz: Dilya o‘qituvchi. Bobur haydovchi. Sara hamshira. Ali muhandis.

scenes.title: Ish joylari: birinchi qism

examples.t: My sister works in an office.

scenes.say_native: Endi ish joylari. “School” — maktab. “Hospital” — kasalxona. “Office” — ofis. “Factory” — zavod. “Shop” — do‘kon. Bu so‘zlar kasblar bilan chambarchas bog‘liq: o‘qituvchi maktabda, shifokor kasalxonada, buxgalter ofisda, ishchi zavodda, sotuvchi do‘konda ishlaydi. Yozib qo‘ying: “office” va “factory” oldidan “an” va “a” ni tanlashga e’tibor bering. “An office”, lekin “a factory”.
scenes.say: A school. A hospital. An office. A factory. A shop.
scenes.say_uz: Maktab. Kasalxona. Ofis. Zavod. Do‘kon.

scenes.title: Ish joylari: ikkinchi qism
scenes.say_native: Yana beshta ish joyi. “Restaurant” — restoran. “Bank” — bank. “Farm” — ferma. “Airport” — aeroport. “Garage” — garaj, ya’ni mashina ta’mirlanadigan joy. Ularni kasblar bilan bog‘lang: oshpaz restoranda, uchuvchi aeroportda, fermer fermada, mexanik garajda. Shu bog‘lanishni yodlash so‘zlarni eslab qolishni ancha osonlashtiradi.
scenes.say: A restaurant. A bank. A farm. An airport. A garage.
scenes.say_uz: Restoran. Bank. Ferma. Aeroport. Garaj.

scenes.title: Kim qayerda ishlaydi?
scenes.say_native: Kasbni ish joyi bilan bog‘lang. Shifokor qayerda ishlaydi? Uchuvchi-chi? Fermer? Oshpaz? Har birini “A doctor works at a hospital” kabi to‘liq gap qilib aytsangiz yaxshi. Hozircha “work” ga “s” qo‘shishga ham harakat qiling: “works”. Gap bitta odam haqida bo‘lgani uchun fe’l oxiriga “s” qo‘shiladi. Shoshilmang va har bir gapni oxirigacha ayting.
scenes.say: A doctor? A pilot? A farmer? A cook?
scenes.say_uz: Shifokor? Uchuvchi? Fermer? Oshpaz?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: A doctor works at a hospital.
A pilot works at an airport.
A farmer works on a farm.
A cook works in a restaurant.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “A doctor works at a hospital”. “A pilot works at an airport”. “A farmer works on a farm”. “A cook works in a restaurant”. Ko‘rdingizmi, yuklama o‘zgaryapti: at, on, in. Bu haqida hozir gaplashamiz. Hozircha shuni bilib oling: “works” da “s” bor, chunki gap bitta odam haqida. Buni keyingi darslarda batafsil o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: A doctor works at a hospital. A pilot works at an airport. A farmer works on a farm. A cook works in a restaurant.
scenes.say_uz: Shifokor kasalxonada ishlaydi. Uchuvchi aeroportda ishlaydi. Fermer fermada ishlaydi. Oshpaz restoranda ishlaydi.

scenes.title: Where do you work?
scenes.say_native: Ish joyini so‘rash uchun “Where do you work?” deymiz, ya’ni “qayerda ishlaysiz?”. Javob: “I work” va keyin yuklama va joy. Yuklamalar o‘zbekchadagi “-da” qo‘shimchasiga to‘g‘ri keladi. Maktab, kasalxona, bank, aeroport, zavod bilan ko‘pincha “at” ishlatamiz. Ofis va do‘kon bilan “in”. Ferma bilan “on”. Bu odatiy birikmalar, ularni birgalikda yodlab oling.
scenes.say: Where do you work? I work at a bank.
scenes.say_uz: Qayerda ishlaysiz? Men bankda ishlayman.

scenes.title: Kasb va ish joyini aralashtirish
scenes.say_native: Ikki xil gapni aralashtirmang. Kasbni aytsangiz — “I’m a” va kasb: “I’m a teacher”. Ish joyini aytsangiz — “I work” va yuklama va joy: “I work at a school”. Xato: “I work teacher”, ya’ni “work” dan keyin to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri kasb. Yoki “I’m a school”. Bu degani “men maktabman”. Ikkalasini bitta gapga yig‘ish mumkin: “I’m a teacher and I work at a school”.
scenes.say: I'm a teacher. I work at a school. I'm a teacher and I work at a school.
scenes.say_uz: Men o‘qituvchiman. Men maktabda ishlayman. Men o‘qituvchiman va maktabda ishlayman.

scenes.title: Kasb va ish joyi
scenes.say_native: Uchta juftlik. Har biri uchun ikkita gap ayting: avval “I’m a” bilan kasbni, keyin “I work” bilan ish joyini. Hamshira va kasalxona. Ofitsiant va restoran. Fermer va ferma. Masalan: “I’m a nurse. I work at a hospital.” Yuklamani to‘g‘ri tanlashga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: Nurse, hospital. Waiter, restaurant. Farmer, farm.
scenes.say_uz: Hamshira, kasalxona. Ofitsiant, restoran. Fermer, ferma.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: I’m a nurse. I work at a hospital.
I’m a waiter. I work in a restaurant.
I’m a farmer. I work on a farm.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “I’m a nurse. I work at a hospital.” “I’m a waiter. I work in a restaurant.” “I’m a farmer. I work on a farm.” Restoran uchun “at a restaurant” ham to‘g‘ri, shuning uchun bu yerda ikkala yuklamani eshitishingiz mumkin. Ferma bilan esa odatda “on” ishlatiladi. Bu birikmalarni yaxlit iboralar sifatida eslab qoling.
scenes.say: I'm a nurse. I work at a hospital. I'm a waiter. I work in a restaurant. I'm a farmer. I work on a farm.
scenes.say_uz: Men hamshiraman. Kasalxonada ishlayman. Men ofitsiantman. Restoranda ishlayman. Men fermerman. Fermada ishlayman.

scenes.title: Boshqa odam haqida so‘rash
board: What does he do? — He’s a driver.
Where does she work? — She works at a bank.
scenes.say_native: Boshqa odam haqida so‘rash uchun “do” o‘rniga “does” ishlatiladi. “What does your father do?” — otangiz kasbi nima? “Where does your sister work?” — opangiz qayerda ishlaydi? Javobda “works” deymiz, oxirida “s” bilan. Bu qoidani sakkizinchi darsda batafsil o‘rganamiz. Hozircha shu ikkita savolni va javob qolipini yodlang, ular bugungi dialogda ham uchraydi.
scenes.say: What does your father do? He's a driver. Where does she work? She works at a bank.
scenes.say_uz: Otangiz nima ish qiladi? U haydovchi. U qayerda ishlaydi? U bankda ishlaydi.

scenes.title: Dialog: ziyofatda
board: Sara: Hi, I’m Sara. What do you do?
Bobur: I’m a mechanic. I work at a garage.
Sara: Oh, nice! I’m a nurse. I work at a hospital.
Bobur: Great! Is it a big hospital?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash dialogi. Ziyofatda ikki yangi tanish suhbatlashyapti: Sara va Bobur. Ular bir-biridan nima ish qilishini so‘rashadi. Tinglang: Bobur kim, qayerda ishlaydi? Sara-chi? Dialogda bugungi savollar va javoblar bor. Keyin savollarga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Sara. What do you do? I'm a mechanic. I work at a garage. Oh, nice! I'm a nurse. I work at a hospital. Great! Is it a big hospital? Yes, it is.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, men Saraman. Siz nima ish qilasiz? Men mexanikman. Garajda ishlayman. Ajoyib! Men hamshiraman. Kasalxonada ishlayman. Zo‘r! U katta kasalxonami? Ha.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha uchta savol. Birinchi: Boburning kasbi nima? Ikkinchi: Sara qayerda ishlaydi? Uchinchi: kasalxona kattami? Har biriga qisqa va to‘g‘ri javob bering. Uchinchi savolga qisqa javob ham mumkin: “Yes” yoki “No” va olmosh bilan fe’l. Dialogni xotirangizda qayta eshiting, keyin gapiring.
scenes.say: What is Bobur's job? Where does Sara work? Is the hospital big?
scenes.say_uz: Boburning kasbi nima? Sara qayerda ishlaydi? Kasalxona kattami?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Boburning kasbi — “He’s a mechanic”, u mexanik. Sara kasalxonada ishlaydi — “She works at a hospital”. Kasalxona katta — “Yes, it is”. Dialog davomida Sara “Is it a big hospital?” deb so‘radi, Bobur esa “it” deb javob berdi, chunki kasalxona narsa. Demak, o‘tgan darsdagi qoidalar bugun ham ishlayapti.
scenes.say: He's a mechanic. She works at a hospital. Yes, it is.
scenes.say_uz: U mexanik. U kasalxonada ishlaydi. Ha, katta.

scenes.title: Dialog: oilaviy rasm
board: Dilya: My father is a driver. He works for a taxi company.
Dilya: My mother is a nurse. She works at a hospital.
Dilya: And my brother Ali is a student.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog — oilaviy surat. Dilya oilasini tanishtiryapti. U otasi va onasi haqida kasbi va ish joyi bilan gapiradi, akasi haqida esa boshqa narsani aytadi. Tinglang: kim nima ish qiladi, kim qayerda ishlaydi. Dialogda “works for a taxi company” ibora bor. “Work for” — kompaniya uchun ishlash degani.
scenes.say: This is my family. My father is a driver. He works for a taxi company. My mother is a nurse. She works at a hospital. And my brother Ali is a student.
scenes.say_uz: Bu mening oilam. Otam haydovchi. U taksi kompaniyasida ishlaydi. Onam hamshira. U kasalxonada ishlaydi. Akam Ali esa talaba.

scenes.title: Savollar
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Dilyaning otasi nima ish qiladi? Onasi qayerda ishlaydi? Ali hamshiramikan? Dialogni eslang va to‘liq gap bilan javob bering. Uchinchisiga “Yes” yoki “No” bilan boshlab, qisqa javob qaytaring. Savolda “Ali” ismi bor, shuning uchun javobda mos olmosh kerak bo‘ladi. Eslab qoling, o‘tgan darsda ham xuddi shunday qildik.
scenes.say: What does Dilya's father do? Where does her mother work? Is Ali a nurse?
scenes.say_uz: Dilyaning otasi nima ish qiladi? Onasi qayerda ishlaydi? Ali hamshiramikan?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) No, he isn’t. He’s a student.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Dilyaning otasi haydovchi — “He’s a driver”. Onasi kasalxonada ishlaydi — “She works at a hospital”. Ali hamshira emas, talaba — “No, he isn’t. He’s a student”. Bu uchinchi javobda bir narsa muhim: “student” ham javob bo‘la oladi, chunki “What do you do?” ga talaba ham “I’m a student” deb javob beradi.
scenes.say: He's a driver. She works at a hospital. No, he isn't. He's a student.
scenes.say_uz: U haydovchi. U kasalxonada ishlaydi. Yo‘q. U talaba.

scenes.title: Ishsiz yoki talaba bo‘lsangiz
board: I’m a student at a university.

examples.t: I’m a student at a university.

scenes.say_native: Hamma ham ishlamaydi, shuning uchun boshqa javoblarni ham biling. Agar o‘qisangiz — “I’m a student”. Universitetda o‘qisangiz — “I’m a student at a university”. Nafaqada bo‘lsangiz — “I’m retired”. Hozir ish qidirayotgan bo‘lsangiz — “I’m looking for a job”. Bu iboralarning birinchisi sizga eng kerakli, chunki ko‘p talaba bu kursda o‘qiydi. Shunga ham tayyor turing.
scenes.say: I'm a student. I'm retired. I'm looking for a job.
scenes.say_uz: Men talabaman. Men nafaqadaman. Men ish qidiryapman.

scenes.title: What do you do? ga noto‘g‘ri javob
scenes.say_native: Bu savolga ko‘pchilik boshida xato javob beradi. “What do you do?” desa, hozirgi harakatni emas, kasbingizni so‘rayapti. Shuning uchun “I’m reading” yoki “I’m studying” deb javob bersangiz, suhbatdosh sizni tushunmaydi. “I’m fine” ham mos emas, bu “How are you?” ga javob. To‘g‘ri javob: “I’m a” va kasb nomi, yoki “I’m a student”.
scenes.say: What do you do? I'm a teacher. Not I'm reading, not I'm fine.
scenes.say_uz: Kasbingiz nima? Men o‘qituvchiman. I'm reading emas, I'm fine emas.

scenes.title: Sizning navbatingiz
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz javob bering. Birinchi savol: “What do you do?” Ikkinchi savol: “Where do you work?” yoki o‘qisangiz “Where do you study?”. Ikkala savolga ham to‘liq gap bilan javob bering. Masalan: “I’m a teacher. I work at a school.” Shoshilmang. Agar o‘zingiznikini bilmasangiz, boshqa odamning kasbini tanlang.
scenes.say: What do you do? Where do you work?
scenes.say_uz: Kasbingiz nima? Qayerda ishlaysiz?

scenes.title: Namuna javoblar
board: I’m a teacher. I work at a school.
I’m a student. I study at a university.
I’m an engineer. I work at a factory.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblar. “I’m a teacher. I work at a school.” “I’m a student. I study at a university.” “I’m an engineer. I work at a factory.” O‘qiyotgan odamlar uchun “work” o‘rniga “study” ishlatiladi, ya’ni o‘qimoq. Sizning javobingiz boshqa bo‘lsa ham muhimi, tuzilishi shu: “I’m a” kasb, keyin “I work at” joy. Shu qolipni hech tushirib qoldirmang.
scenes.say: I'm a teacher. I work at a school. I'm a student. I study at a university.
scenes.say_uz: Men o‘qituvchiman. Maktabda ishlayman. Men talabaman. Universitetda o‘qiyman.

scenes.title: Uchta odam haqida gapiring
scenes.say_native: Oxirgi vazifa: oilangiz yoki do‘stlaringizdan uch kishi haqida gapiring. Har biri uchun ikki gap: kasbi va ish joyi. Masalan: “My father is a driver. He works for a taxi company.” “My friend Anna is a nurse. She works at a hospital.” Agar kasbi sizga noma’lum bo‘lsa, ro‘yxatdagi yigirmata kasbdan birini tanlang.
scenes.say: Tell me about three people. What do they do? Where do they work?
scenes.say_uz: Uch kishi haqida ayting. Ular nima ish qiladi? Qayerda ishlaydi?

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: He works for a taxi company.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: “My father is a driver. He works for a taxi company. My sister is a dentist. She works at a clinic. My friend is a teacher. He works at a school.” Sizning gaplaringiz boshqacha bo‘ladi. Muhimi, har bir odam uchun avval kasb, keyin ish joyi, va “a” yoki “an” ni unutmaslik. Agar buni uddalagan bo‘lsangiz, bugungi maqsadga yetdingiz.
scenes.say: My father is a driver. He works for a taxi company. My sister is a dentist. She works at a clinic.
scenes.say_uz: Otam haydovchi. U taksi kompaniyasida ishlaydi. Singlim tish shifokori. U klinikada ishlaydi.

scenes.title: Qisqacha takrorlaymiz
board: What do you do? → I’m a / an …
Where do you work? → I work at / in / on …
scenes.say_native: Bugungi darsni eslaymiz. Birinchi: “What do you do?” — kasb so‘raydi, javob “I’m a” yoki “I’m an” bilan boshlanadi. Ikkinchi: yigirmata kasb nomi, beshta guruhga bo‘lib o‘rgandik. Uchinchi: kasb oldida artikl, unli oldida “an”. To‘rtinchi: ish joylari va “Where do you work?” Beshinchi: “at”, “in”, “on” yuklamalari. Oltinchi: kasb nomlarining urg‘usi.
scenes.say: Today you learned twenty jobs, workplaces and the questions: What do you do? Where do you work?
scenes.say_uz: Bugun yigirmata kasb, ish joylari va savollarni o‘rgandingiz: What do you do? Where do you work?

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: I’m a … / He is a … / She works at …
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi. O‘zingiz bilgan beshta odam haqida yozing yoki ayting: ular nima ish qiladi va qayerda ishlaydi. Har biri uchun kamida ikkita gap bo‘lsin. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: o‘nta gapda kasb nomi oldida to‘g‘ri “a” yoki “an” turishi va ish joyi to‘g‘ri yuklama bilan aytilishi. Keyingi darsda soat, kun tartibi va vaqtni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Homework: say what five people you know do and where they work.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: o‘zingiz bilgan beshta odam nima ish qilishini va qayerda ishlashini ayting.

homework_uz: O‘zingiz bilgan beshta odam haqida ayting yoki yozing: ular nima ish qiladi va qayerda ishlaydi (masalan: My father is a driver. He works for a taxi company.). Har bir gapda kasb oldida to‘g‘ri a yoki an va ish joyida to‘g‘ri at, in yoki on bo‘lsin.

quiz.q: What does ‘What do you do?’ ask about?
quiz.why_uz: What do you do? kasbni so‘raydi, hozirgi harakatni emas.
Engineer unli tovush bilan boshlanadi, shuning uchun an.
Kasb oldida a kerak va am/is/are ni tushirmaslik kerak.
Shifokor kasalxonada, ya’ni hospital da ishlaydi.

quiz.q: Where do you work? Choose the best answer.
quiz.why_uz: Where savoliga joy bilan javob beramiz: I work at a hospital.

quiz.q: Which word is for a man or a woman?
quiz.why_uz: Doctor ikkala jins uchun ham ishlatiladi.
Farm bilan odatda on ishlatiladi: on a farm.

quiz.q: Which is the best word for policeman and policewoman?
quiz.why_uz: Bugun ikkala jins uchun police officer ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: My father is a driver. He works ___ a taxi company.
